snippet.title: Luminous Jigsaw Puzzles, wish list on Steam
snippet.description:
The first video game from my studio is here and here is hoping we have more and more of my art released in many puzzle packs and forms. Make sure to wish list it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4498280/Luminous_Jigsaw_Puzzles/
Step away from the noise of the world and enter the enchanting realms of Luminous Ages. This isn't just a puzzle game; it’s a journey through a vibrant multiverse brought to life by the breathtaking, hand-illustrated gallery of renowned fantasy creator Anthony Christou.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere of magic and myth. Whether you are piecing together a majestic dragon or a celestial horoscope, you’ll find a serene sanctuary designed to spark wonder. From the first piece to the final click, experience the satisfying glow of vibrant colours and hidden details emerging under your fingertips.

Key Features
Puzzles for Every Pace: Tailor your challenge with five difficulty settings, from a cozy 50 pieces to an epic 1,250-piece masterpiece.

Stress-Free Solving: Use helpful features like Edge Piece Highlighting and Next Piece Guidance to keep your experience smooth and meditative.

Chase Your Best: For those who love a gentle challenge, track your completion times and scores to see your mastery grow.
